title_en: 'Looks Way Better Than He Did in the Marvels' — Marvel Shows Off First Look at Kelsey Grammer's Beast in Avengers: Doomsday, and Fans Are Divided
summary_en: We’ve gotten our first look at Kelsey Grammer’s Beast as he will appear in Avengers: Doomsday, prompting fan confusion about why Marvel waited so long to reveal him and comparisons to his appearance at the end of The Marvels.
body_en:
We’ve gotten our first look at Kelsey Grammer’s Beast as he will appear in Avengers: Doomsday, prompting fan confusion about why Marvel waited so long to reveal him and sparking comparisons to his appearance at the end of The Marvels.
This first look comes courtesy of Entertainment Weekly , which shared a high-resolution image of the furry blue mutant looking on with a mystified expression. The outlet’s report states that Kelsey Grammer was the second X-Men veteran to join the cast of Doomsday following the late great Patrick Stewart , making his first comeback appearance in a post-credits scene in The Marvels.
Apparently, Grammer’s scene was so well-received that Marvel decided to bring him back for their upcoming Avengers adventure. EW says that Grammer was told that he received “a lot of great response from that little cameo" — a sentiment that fans echoed in comments across social media.
First look at Kelsey Grammer as Beast in ‘AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY’.
(Source: https://t.co/K3CgumiaKe) https://t.co/a8YApJ0XhS
Most were puzzled as to why Marvel waited so long to show off the character, though some are at odds with his updated design in comparison to how he looked in The Marvels.
“Why were they so reluctant to show Beast fully, he actually doesn’t even look bad?” one confused commenter wrote.
“Looks way better than he did in The Marvels, why were they hiding him?” another asked.
“I like it, even though his appearance in The Marvels looked better,” yet another posited.
This film will mark the fourth time Grammer has portrayed Beast; he first took up the mantle in 2006's X-Men: The Last Stand , and reprised the role in X-Men: Days of Future Past in 2014. Almost a decade after this, he once again appeared as the character in 2023's The Marvels, and will once again play the part in Avengers: Doomsday in just a few weeks' time.
IGN got the chance to speak with Grammer after Days of Future Past, who told us he would "love" to do another X-Men movie. "I loved playing the Beast," he told us. "I called him the Blue Guy. It was just a joy for me to be involved in that franchise.
"Actually, when I heard they were making another one, it was Hugh [Jackman]. I was talking to him, and somebody said, 'Oh, you're going to be in the next one, mate.' And I said, 'Well, I didn't even know about it.'"
A slew of characters have already been confirmed to appear in Avengers: Doomsday. A recent trailer for the film showed off a few of the teams we can expect to throw down in the movie, which, of course, includes the X-Men. And a new poster also gave fans an up-close-and-personal look at Doctor Doom's metal mask, which some fans can't help but compare to another Marvel poster of Iron Man.
